name: XSD/WETH pool burnpoolXSD reentrancy
summary: swapXSDForETH() sends ETH with TransferHelper.safeTransferETH() before it updates the pool's accounting, letting the attacker re-enter burnpoolXSD() from the receive hook and drain the pool.
